allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When a Spanish Jesuit goes into the South American wilderness to build a mission in the hope of converting the Indians of the region, a slave hunter is converted and joins his mission. When Spain sells the colony to Portugal, they are forced to defend all they have built against the Portuguese aggressors.

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: Two mood values (thoughtful, emotional) are grounded, but Action/Adventure tagging leaves open whether exciting should also apply; human review is recommended.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When territorial treaties hand the settlement over to hostile forces, how long can a sanctuary built on faith stand against imperial aggression?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In the 18th-century South American wilderness, a Spanish Jesuit establishes a remote mission among the Guaraní. After a slave hunter undergoes a conversion and joins the work, colonial powers threaten to raze it all.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A thoughtful, emotionally heavy historical adventure paced with deliberate gravitas and high dramatic stakes.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Roland Joffé directs a sweeping historical drama where personal redemption collides with colonial warfare, staging epic moral questions across a striking natural landscape.
